task_metadata.research_topic: contrastive protein-ligand virtual screening scoring objectives
task_metadata.research_question: Design the scoring objective, including projection heads, embedding space, and training loss, for contrastive protein-ligand virtual screening.
notes: Baselines and tests were mapped from config.json and linked to sourced benchmark/method papers where available.

tests.label: train
tests.notes: Training stage for the shared scoring objective.

tests.label: dude
tests.notes: DUD-E benchmark and an early machine-learning scoring baseline evaluated on DUD-E.

tests.label: lit-pcba
tests.notes: LIT-PCBA benchmark and a docking paper that reports results on LIT-PCBA.

tests.label: dekois
tests.notes: DEKOIS 2.0 benchmark plus related decoy and chemotype analysis papers.

baselines.name: hcc
baselines.notes: Euclidean contrastive + ranking ablation drawn from HypSeek.

baselines.name: hcc_hyp_cone
baselines.notes: Full HypSeek-style hyperbolic + cone hierarchy baseline.
